title: Interview Notice for the post of Deputy Registrar/ Deputy Controller of Examinations

source.name: University of Kashmir, Jammu and Kashmir

text:
KEY LINES:
16-02-2023 shall be conducted on 19-08-2023 at 11.00 am in the Committee Room of the

FULL TEXT:
University of Kashmir
NAAC Accredited Grade A+
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar 190006, Kashmir.
NOTICE
It is notified for information of all the eligible candidates that the interview for the Post of
Deputy Registrar/ Deputy Controller of Examinations advertised vide notice dated
16-02-2023 shall be conducted on 19-08-2023 at 11.00 am in the Committee Room of the
Vice Chancellor’s Secretariat, University of Kashmir, Hazratbal, Srinagar - 190006.
The concerned eligible candidates have been informed over telephone and the call letters
have been despatched to them at their respective addresses / e.mails.
Candidates shall be required to produce original documents in support of their
candidature at the time of interview and shall report atleast 30 minutes before the
scheduled time for document verification.
Sd/-
Deputy Registrar
(Recruitment)
No. KU/Rect/Interview/23
Dated: 17th August, 2023
